rule_metadata.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rule_metadata.title: HackTool - Defendnot Default Scheduled Task Activity

rules.rule_text:
title: HackTool - Defendnot Default Scheduled Task Activity
id: 015ff932-4156-41ae-9d4c-1443995611fd
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the default scheduled task activity of the hacktool Defendnot,
  which is used to disable Windows Defender Security.

  It abuses Microsoft''s undocumented WSC API to register itself as a fake antivirus
  product, allowing it to disable Windows Defender.

  During installation, Defendnot creates a scheduled task named ''defendnot'' with
  the argument ''--from-autorun'' for persistence.

  '
references:
- https://github.com/es3n1n/defendnot/blob/525176a37721ead27d3f9f77f59b58abfc305988/README.md
- https://www.huntress.com/blog/defendnot-detecting-malicious-security-product-bypass-techniques
author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
date: 2026-10-18
tags:
- attack.execution
- attack.persistence
- attack.privilege-escalation
- attack.defense-impairment
- attack.t1053.005
- attack.t1685
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection_eid:
    EventID:
    - 4698
    - 4702
  selection_task:
  - TaskName: \defendnot
  - TaskContent|contains:
    - defendnot
    - <Arguments>--from-autorun</Arguments>
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: high
